Unlock the power of intermittent fasting to reach your goal weight and get healthy. No diet and no yo-yo effect. Improve your metabolic health  and feel full of energy.

What is intermittent fasting?
Intermittent fasting is one of the most popular health and fitness trends. Instead of a diet, it's an eating pattern that cycles between periods of fasting and eating. It doesn't specify which foods you should eat or avoid, but when you should eat.
Today, we eat 3–4 (or more) meals per day, and never feel hungry. This requires our organs to work hard all the time, and never take a break from digesting. Our eating habits may result in obesity and health problems, such as diabetes.
When fasting, your body will detoxify, burn fat and regenerate. After a few weeks, you'll feel healthier and more active. 

Gradual fasting plans, suitable for all! 
Create your own fasting plan 13-11, 15-9, 16-10, 16-8, 18-6, 20-4, 23-1, 24, 36, 48, Custom
5+2 Weekly Plan : During the week, eat normally for 5 days, and choose another 2 days for a little control.Women take 500Kcal and men take 600Kcal on fasting days. You can choose to take it all at once, but a better choice is to divide 600Kcal into two meals, 250Kcal for breakfast and 350Kcal for dinner. The food should preferably be some food with high protein content but low glycemic index (GI). It is not recommended to completely eliminate carbohydrates. When eating, chew slowly and savor well. The fasting days need to be separated, such as Monday and Thursday. This light fasting plan is healthy, effective and easy to implement, allowing you to lose weight easily while enjoying the other benefits of fasting. It can be performed long-term, gradually turning it into a healthy lifestyle.
16-8 is the most popular fasting plan for weight loss. With 16 hours fasting period, your body will gradually get used to fasting.

What Is Intermittent Fasting?
What usually comes to mind when most people hear of Intermittent Fasting (IF), is that it is just another crazy fad diet to lose weight with little effort. However, it isn't a diet at all, but rather an eating pattern. It’s not what you eat, but when you eat it that is important.
Depending on what type of fasting you schedule, you generally will have a time window where you are allowed to eat all the food you want. As soon as that window is over though, you don't eat ANYTHING until the window comes up again. For example, a common approach is 16 hour fasts with an 8 hour eating window every day.
There are dozens of different type of fasting diets, and with MyFast you can utilize any plan such as:
16/8 - Lean Gains
5:2 - Eat normal for 5 days, and IF the remaining 2

Fasting is one decision a day. Most fasting apps turn it into forty.

A streak to protect. Badges to earn. Water, weight and steps to log. A dozen pings before lunch. None of it helps at the hour you want to eat, and all of it is one more thing to fall behind on. Steady is a timer, one check-in before the hour you usually quit, something to do while that hour passes, and a record that tells the truth. That is the whole app.

Hungry is easy. Tired, hungry and low, all at once, is what beats you. That stack lands around the same hour of a fast and lifts not long after, and no timer notices. Steady learns when it hits you, checks in just ahead of it, gives you three minutes of slow breathing to get through it, and two hours later shows you, from your own record, that it passed.

WHAT IT IS
- A fasting timer for 12 to 20 hour windows.
- One check-in, two taps: pick a mood, log it.
- Three minutes of paced breathing when a check-in is low. The circle fills, you breathe in; it empties, you breathe out. A gentle pulse in your hand marks each breath, so you can shut your eyes. Works offline.
- A small puzzle if mindful breathing is not your thing. A new one every time. No clock, no score.
- Then one question: how is it now? Steady keeps the answer and tells you plainly whether it lifted.
- Or water and a ten-minute wait, with the drink picked for the time of day. Water first, nothing with caffeine late.
- An honest record: how many you finished, your longest, and how often you felt better a little later after a low check-in, with the fasts you ended early counted against it. The You tab shows what got you through, counted from your own record.

WHAT IT IS NOT
- No streaks at all. No badges, no fire icons. Nothing resets, so there is nothing to lose.
- No water, weight or step logging. No meditation library to keep up with either.
- No social feed, no ads, no analytics.
- No inflated stages. Steady tops out at 20 hours and does not claim autophagy or ketosis, because they do not happen at 16 hours.

IT WILL TELL YOU TO STOP
Tap anything physical during a check-in (shaky, dizzy, heart racing) and Steady tells you to stop and eat, whatever the hour.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
No account. No server. Everything Steady knows about you lives in a local database on your iPhone, and nothing you enter is sent anywhere. It all works offline. Delete the app and it is gone.

Steady is not a medical device and does not give medical advice. If you take insulin, a sulfonylurea or an SGLT2 inhibitor, or have any condition affected by not eating, talk to your doctor before fasting. If you feel unwell during a fast, stop and eat.

It shows you exactly which biological phase your body is in right now, and explains the science behind it with cited primary sources, not marketing copy. If you have ever wondered how to track fasting properly, or what is actually happening during a fast, this is the fasting tracker built for that question.

WHY FASTING WORKS

Intermittent fasting works because of what happens between meals, not just the absence of food. As your fast progresses, your body moves through distinct phases: burning through glucose reserves, shifting into fat burning lipolysis, entering ketosis, and eventually triggering autophagy, the cellular repair process linked to longevity and metabolic health. Understanding these transitions is what separates intentional fasting from guesswork. Intermittent maps every stage so your goals are grounded in biology, not motivation.

KEY FEATURES

PHASE AWARE FASTING TIMER
A real time timer that tracks six biological phases: Fed, Early Fasting, Lipolysis, Ketosis, Autophagy, and Deep Fast. Each phase links to a free science article with primary sources cited.

EVERY FASTING PROTOCOL, ONE APP

results.description:
You don’t need another fasting app begging for your attention and tracking your data.

Ocras is a simple fasting app built around one question: am I eating right now, or fasting?

Set your eating window once, add a widget to your Home Screen, Lock Screen, or Apple Watch, and that’s pretty much it. Ocras works out your current fasting state from your schedule and shows it at a glance.

There’s no need to start or stop a fast manually. No notifications telling you when to eat. No account to create. You shouldn’t have to open the app several times a day just to keep a fasting timer accurate.

If it’s 3pm on a Tuesday, Ocras should simply be able to tell you at a glance whether you’re inside your eating window, without you unlocking your phone.

What Ocras does

* Set a different eating window for each day of the week, or use the same schedule every day
* Choose from common schedules like 16:8, 18:6, 20:4 and OMAD, or make your own
* Add widgets to your Home Screen and Lock Screen
* Add widgets and complications to your Apple Watch
* Choose from different widget styles, including the original designs, retro-inspired widgets and vaporwave themes
* Check your fasting status without opening the app
* Works completely offline - no cloud needed

What Ocras deliberately does not do:

* There are no notifications.
* There’s no social feed or sharing.
* There’s no account to maintain.
* There’s no internet connection required for the core app (only if you want to unlock the additional widgets).
* Your schedule and fasting data stay on your device - Ocras does not track anything about you.

The aim is to keep Ocras useful without turning fasting into another thing you need to manage.

Still growing:

I’m continuing to add new widget designs, including more customisation options, and support for longer multi-day fasts is planned too.

For now, Ocras is intentionally small: set your schedule, put a widget somewhere useful, and get on with your day.

Set once. Glance when you need it.

Happy fasting!

You already “fast” when you sleep. Intermittent fasting is just a pattern of eating that includes more “fasts” during the day.

results.description:
Built for your body, not his.
Most fasting apps were designed around male physiology. One window, same hours every day, applied to everyone. That's not how your body works. You have a cycle, and your hormones change pretty much everything: hunger, energy, sleep, how recovery feels.
Fastelle is built around that cycle instead of pretending it doesn't exist.

Fasting that moves with your cycle
Your hunger in week one is not the same animal as your hunger in week three. Fastelle knows where you are in your cycle and adjusts your windows accordingly. During your period it pulls things back. Through follicular and ovulation, when most women feel strongest, it lets you push a bit. Then in the luteal stretch, when cravings and fatigue usually spike, it eases off again. You stop white-knuckling through fasts that were never written with you in mind.

See what's actually happening
The timer walks you through the six stages of a fast, from rising blood sugar through fat burn into autophagy. Hour 14 looks different from hour 16, and the app shows you why, so the time stops feeling like dead waiting.

Food that follows the same logic
Log meals, calories, protein, carbs and fat in one place. Your daily targets shift with your phase, because day 2 you and day 14 you are basically two different people, nutritionally speaking.

A plan that's actually yours
No off-the-shelf protocol pulled from someone else's body. Your week is shaped by your cycle, your goals, and what you can realistically handle right now. You can see what's coming in the next phase, which makes it easier to plan groceries, workouts and social stuff around it.

Progress you can see
Fasting streaks, weekly hours, hydration, weight trend, nutrition. All in one view, so you can tell whether what you're doing is actually working.
For PCOS, irregular cycles, and bodies that don't behave
Fastelle works whether you've been fasting for years or you're just trying it this week. It doesn't assume your cycle is textbook regular. It doesn't assume your body is the same every day. For most women, it isn't.

Download Fastelle.

Ayuname follows your intermittent fast and explains, hour by hour, what each phase is said to involve. It is educational information: the app counts time, it does not measure anything about your body.

THE FASTING PHASES, EXPLAINED
• Fed state (0h): digestion under way
• Drawing on stores (4h): the body uses what it has stored
• Fat burning (12h): a greater use of stored fat is described
• Early ketosis (16h): ketone bodies appear
• Full ketosis (18h): ketones matter more as fuel
• Autophagy (24h): cellular recycling, studied mostly in animals
• Prolonged fast (36h)
• Three-day fast (72h): usually done with supervision

THE PLAN THAT FITS YOU
16:8, 18:6, 20:4, OMAD and long fasts. Change it whenever you want.

YOUR FULL HISTORY
Every fast, your streaks and months of progress.

AN ALERT AT EVERY PHASE
We tell you when the timer reaches a new phase.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
Works without an account. With one, your history survives a new phone.

Free, no ads. Optional premium features.

Ayuname is a wellness app: it is not a medical device, it does not diagnose or treat any condition, and it is not a substitute for medical advice. Talk to your doctor before fasting, especially if you are pregnant, taking medication or living with a medical condition.
